summary: Frontend tests for new TransportPublicPage features (favorites Maison/Travail, journey history, share button, deep-link). All 4 features validated end-to-end with role=user test2@example.com. No JS errors, no UI bugs.

favorites.fav_home_btn_note: ABSENT — expected (compte test n'a pas de Maison enregistrée). Per request, this is NOT a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: shareJourney catches all errors silently (line 175 'cancelled' comment). Could log share failures for debugging clipboard permission denials.

Minor: journey-share-btn is always rendered inside the journey-result block, even when neither bus nor VTC found. Sharing an empty journey is harmless (toast still copies the from→to URL), so this is acceptable.

Note: when only from_lat (or only to_lat) is provided in the deep-link, the useEffect (line 153) requires BOTH to set state. Single-point deep-links are silently ignored. This is intentional but undocumented.
seed_data_creation: Cleaned + recreated journey history items via deep-link auto-save during tests. Backend test2 user has work address '5 Rue Travail' saved (home=null).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compte test2@example.com a uniquement 'work' enregistré (pas de home). Pour tester fav-home-btn, ajouter une adresse 'home' via /api/places/saved (PUT). Le deep-link est la méthode la plus fiable pour générer un journey-result en E2E car bypass Google Places autocomplete. La clipboard read nécessite grant_permissions(['clipboard-read', 'clipboard-write']) en Playwright.
